name: Nekocafe
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood cat cafe (Fuwaneko Cafe): a notice about the cat-petting time limit changing, a first day working part-time at the front desk, a price-and-rules guide, an online reservation system starting, a comparison of new-staff training plans, a lesson learned about customer-focused service, teaching a new trainee how to brush the cats, an essay on why online reservations started, a guide for a rescue-cat adoption event, a column on how reservations changed the daily flow, a new year-end rule standard, a reflection on the meaning of a veteran staff member's skill at reading cats, and a one-year cooperation report with a local cat rescue group. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
